title: Simulador Oficial Completo TOEIC® - Versión 9
description: Simulador completo real de Listening & Reading enfocado en Titan Logistics y el líder the Procurement Director.

parts.visual:
## 📝 Simulador Oficial TOEIC® (Versión 9)

Evaluación de **Listening & Reading** en tiempo real:

1. **Listening Section**: Evalúa tu comprensión en Titan Logistics usando FlexCRM.
2. **Reading Section**: Mide tu análisis gramatical de memorandos emitidos por the Procurement Director.

*Inicia tu prueba simulada oficial.*
parts.audio: Welcome to the Full TOEIC Simulation. Manage your time efficiently across both listening and reading stages. Let's begin.

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTO]: Select the best description of Titan Logistics's office photo.
questions.audio_script: A) They are signing the supplier agreement. B) They are inspecting raw materials. C) The shipping container is being loaded. D) They are negotiating the purchase orders.
questions.explanation: Los ejecutivos están sentados discutiendo las cláusulas y montos de las órdenes de compra de materias primas.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the dialogue and answer: What does the man agree to do next?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi John, did the procurement team at Titan Logistics approve the contract?
W: Yes. The Procurement Director wants us to submit the finalized purchase orders in FlexCRM.
M: I will handle the system upload right away.
options: Sign the contract as currently written.
Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
Write a new memorandum to sales staff.
questions.correct_answer: Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
questions.explanation: El hombre dice: 'I will call their manager to negotiate an extension'.

questions.question:
[PART 5]: Complete the business sentence correctly:

"All employees are strictly required to comply ___ the updated security rules in FlexCRM."
questions.explanation: El verbo 'comply' rige gramaticalmente la preposición 'with' (comply with / cumplir con).

questions.question:
[PART 7]: Read the memorandum and answer: **When will the migration to FlexCRM officially occur?**

**MEMORANDUM**

*To:* Purchasing Agents
*From:* Procurement Department
*Subject: Vendor Contracts & FlexCRM Registry*

Please note that starting this weekend, all supplier agreements must be recorded in FlexCRM. An interactive review session will be held this next Friday at 12:00 PM in Conference Room 101.
questions.explanation: El memorando dice: 'starting next next Friday, we are officially retiring our legacy sales tool and migrating to FlexCRM'.
